verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a release note saying users can share images of existing data, such as spreadsheets, for Poke to extract and turn into tables and charts. That is a narrow, image-based form of file analysis. Nothing documents uploading document files, spreadsheet files, or PDFs, or describes how accurate the analysis is. Missing for 10: direct upload of documents, spreadsheets, and PDFs; analysis of native file contents; evidence of accuracy; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can upload documents, spreadsheets, and PDFs and get accurate analysis of their contents

citations.quote: share images of existing data (like spreadsheets) for Poke to extract and visualize
